title: SKF_QUICK_SKILL_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-quick-skill prints, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_QUICK_SKILL_RESULT_JSON: ': on stdout when a run finishes (step 6, finalize), and on stderr at every HARD HALT. The shared emitter (skf-emit-result-envelope.py) builds both from a staged payload, so pipelines branch on status, exit_code and halt_reason without parsing the human-readable output. A --batch run prints one per target.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when step 6 finished the run, 'error' at every HARD HALT.

exit_code.description: The exit code of the halt-contract.md table, derived from halt_reason: null gives 0, input-invalid 2, resolution-failure 3, write-failure 4, overwrite-cancelled 5, user-cancelled 6, finalize-blocked 7, ecosystem-redirect 8, not-skf-output and flat-layout 9.

phase.description: The step slug where the HARD HALT fired (resolve-target, ecosystem-check, quick-extract, compile, write-and-validate or finalize), on-activation for a halt before the run starts (SKILL.md On Activation, or batch mode's refusal of --description and --exports), or batch-mode for a batch that cannot start (batch mode section 1). Null on success.

halt_reason.description: Null on success. The failure class of a HARD HALT, the same value as error.code: pipelines branch on it without grepping the message.

message.description: The halt's reason, the one-line form of the message the step displayed.

details.description: Optional phase-specific context, for example the folder the ownership halt refused (details.folder) or the file a failed write named (details.failed_path).

error.description: Null on success. The failure of a HARD HALT.

active_pointer.description: Path of the {skill_group}/active pointer the run flipped; absent when it was skipped.

outputs.description: The files the run wrote, by kind. Empty at a HARD HALT before step 5 writes; a later halt lists what was already on disk.

skill_name.description: The name the skill was written under ({repo_name}).

version.description: The version folder the run wrote.

language.description: The primary language the run compiled.

exports_documented.description: The exports the compiled SKILL.md documents.

quality_score.description: skill-check's quality score (0 to 100) of the written package, from step 5. Null when skill-check did not run. It is the score every workflow's skill-check pass computes, not a test-skill score.

repo_shape.description: The repository shape step 3 recorded, null when it recorded none (a plain library).

language_resolution.description: How step 1 chose the language: from a language hint, detected with no competing manifest, the first of several manifests picked by a headless run, or confirmed by the user at the multi-language gate.

detected_languages.description: Every manifest language step 1 detected, in priority order.

zero_exports_rescue.description: Set when step 3 found no export and no README description and the run went on anyway: a user choice or a headless default.

active_pointer.description: The kind of {skill_group}/active pointer step 6 flipped, or why it flipped none.

validation_issues.description: The advisory issues step 5's validators returned for each heading of its validation report: skill_md (skill-check's diagnostics, or the frontmatter validator's issues without it, plus the body checks), context_snippet, metadata and security (skill-check's security findings). Auto-fixed issues count nothing, and a check that did not run counts 0.

summary.description: Empty at a HARD HALT. On success, the run's facts a pipeline branches on.

skill_package.description: Absolute path of {skill_package} once step 5 computed it; null before, and at the step 5 ownership halt (the refused folder is in error.details.folder).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the emitter stamped from the clock.

run_id.description: The run folder's id, stamped by the emitter; a --batch target's is the batch run's id and the target's number.

result_path.description: The per-run result file this envelope's call wrote under {skill_package}, or null when it wrote none (every halt before metadata.json exists).

gate.description: The gate that resolved without a person, named after its step and the gate the step file labels.

default_action.description: The gate's documented default (for example 'C' or 'Y').

reason.description: Why, for example 'headless: no user to prompt'.

evidence.description: Optional gate-specific data, such as the detected languages or the package that was overwritten.

headless_decisions.description: One entry per gate that resolved on its own during this run, recorded in the run folder's sink the moment it decided. Empty for an interactive run.

warnings.description: Non-fatal anomalies, one string each, such as also_found_in (a package name another registry also holds, kept at the first registry's pick) or customization_resolver_unavailable. Empty when none.
